title: 1 Hour Axe Throwing Session
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the ordinary and unleash your inner tiki god at Orlando, Florida’s premier axe-throwing venue. Immerse yourself in a vibrant tropical atmosphere and learn of the Legend of Captain Bananas as you channel your inner warrior and master the art of axe throwing. Challenge friends, family, or colleagues to a friendly competition, or simply unwind with a refreshing beverage and enjoy the electrifying ambiance. We are the ultimate destination for an epic axe-throwing experience.

We have 16 tropically themed lanes (with 13 different games to play) and plenty of seating for food and drink.

We serve a wide selection of craft and domestic beer and wine, along with soft drinks. You can order food from many places within our shopping center and other nearby restaurants.

Don’t miss out on a great time! Come hang out with us.
